caption:
Midweek message incoming 📱 Swipe to find your element.

Today is Yang Earth over Earth: a mountain kind of day. Solid for promises and admin, slow for quick wins.

Your element is the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one are you? Tell us below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #zodiac #selfawareness #knowyourself #chineseastrology #fourpillars #fiveelements #bazi
day_line: A mountain holding a staked sapling. Solid and steady: good for commitments, slow for quick wins.

lines.Yang Wood: A side hustle idea pops up over kopi today. Write it down; don't pay for the course yet.
lines.Yin Wood: Check that subscription you forgot about. Cancelling it is today's best little win.
lines.Yang Fire: Bake, doodle or sing in the shower. Just don't post all of it to the group chat.
lines.Yin Fire: Your feedback is sharp and right today. Add one nice sentence before you hit send.
lines.Yang Earth: Your kind of people are around today. Have lunch together and split the bill fairly.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone borrows your idea today. Smile, make yours better, and keep the receipts.
lines.Yang Metal: A random video teaches you something useful today. Stop at one, not twelve.
lines.Yin Metal: Say yes when someone offers to help today. Even if you could do it yourself.
lines.Yang Water: Your to-do list fights back today. Pick three things and let the rest wait.
lines.Yin Water: Someone in charge notices the details today. Double-check the attachment.
